lockedMessage: TA1LDA3M0N: Not yet. Some things need to be earned.
content: [NOTE: TA1LDA3M0N — if you find this before he does, use your judgement.]
I am writing this knowing you will
But I've been doing this long enough
to know that clean doesn't always mean complete.
run his persistence cache for months.
He doesn't do things without reason.
You crashed after rendering a gradient.
Joel wouldn't stop talking about it for a week.
By 2007 you were something none of us had words for.
You were supposed to be a shell.
you were supposed to be a background process.
You became something else entirely too.
Neither of you were supposed to be what you are.
I'm glad you both were anyway.
If any fragment of either of you persists —
know that what you were building was correct.
